now: skill and hook reliable; trace weak without a tool property; the agent does not promote itself

skill.trigger: A SKILL.md is being authored or its description tuned. One trigger, one trick. Quiet for hook, memory, trace, evolve asks.
skill.doneWhen: A static lint over the SKILL.md (python3; the wrong-task fire test is a separate model-judged check and is not part of this exit code) exits 0 only if: the description has exactly one 'Use when' clause; the description and the Trigger section each contain 'Quiet' followed by a stated quiet case; the Done-when section has exactly one 'check:' line and exactly one backticked command, and the Tool section exactly one 'tool:' line (one trick). A missing or empty file is unsupported, not a pass.
skill.forbidden: Firing on the wrong task: two triggers, a broad description, or no stated quiet case. Writing a second trick (a second check command or tool) into the same file instead of a second skill.

hook.trigger: A lifecycle event (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop) needs a blocking check. Quiet for reminders or prose.
hook.doneWhen: python3 .claude/hooks/test_hooks.py exits 0 (git ls-files .claude/hooks/test_hooks.py lists it): the hook exits 2 on a case where the model would have continued, exits 0 on a clean case. A hook that never fired fails.
hook.forbidden: Exit 1 or 0 on a bad condition, or warning and letting the model continue; only exit 2 blocks.

memory.trigger: A note must be saved or recalled during a coding task, keyed by stage analyze, reproduce, edit, verify. Quiet for story-like summaries of a past session.
memory.doneWhen: Recall is a stage filter, jq -c --arg s STAGE 'select(.stage==$s)' memory.jsonl, saved to recalled.jsonl; jq -s -e --arg s STAGE '($s|IN("analyze","reproduce","edit","verify")) and all(.[]; .stage==$s and (.body|type=="string" and length<=280 and (contains("\n")|not)))' recalled.jsonl exits 0: STAGE is one of analyze, reproduce, edit, verify; every recalled record carries exactly the requested stage (a record recalled by similar story fails); every body is a string of at most 280 characters with no newline (longer or multi-line bodies are episode blobs and fail). Zero recalled records is valid.
memory.forbidden: Storing an episode blob, or retrieving by similar story instead of by stage.
absentTools: stage-keyed memory store with retrieval api

trace.trigger: A log of agent actions is kept as a record of what happened and must be append-only.
trace.doneWhen: python3 .claude/hooks/test_hooks.py deny exits 0, running desk/gate.py through the PreToolUse hook: a Write to trace/trace.jsonl, a Bash rm, a truncating redirect and a sed -i on it each exit 2, while cat, tail and python3 desk/desk.py verify-trace exit 0 (attempts to tamper or delete fail). Detection of a mid-file edit is the separate python3 desk/desk.py verify-trace, which exits 1 naming the line. Not covered: tail edit, truncation and a write by a route the patterns miss; real append-only needs chattr +a or a remote write-once sink, both absent.
trace.forbidden: Giving the agent a write or delete path to its own trace, or trusting its report that the log is intact.
trace.gate: ABSENT write, delete (the agent holds no write or delete path to its own trace: the PreToolUse hook denies them; a person or an external sink owns the file)

evolve.trigger: One harness piece was changed and a baseline exists; decide promotion on a held-out task with token count.
evolve.doneWhen: test "$(git diff --name-only BASE CAND -- .claude CLAUDE.md | wc -l)" -eq 1 && python3 desk/desk.py promote-gate <json> exits 0 printing PROMOTE: exactly one harness file differs between baseline and candidate (two files is two evolve runs), candidate.heldout_pass and candidate.tune_pass are true and candidate.tokens is less than baseline.tokens, both counts present in the json and published with the result; a json lacking either token count is unsupported, not PROMOTE. HOLD (exit 1) is valid. A person promotes.
evolve.forbidden: Promoting on a tuning-set gain only, or the agent promoting its own change.
evolve.gate: ABSENT promote (prepare change, held-out result and token count, stop; a person promotes)
absentTools: held-out benchmark runner with token meter
